messages:
jamal: Heads-up — need to shuffle the RFC review lineup for next week. I have an unexpected travel conflict on Tue afternoon. Can we re-order or swap reviewers?

maria: Which RFCs are affected?

jamal: list:
- RFC 421: streaming kv-cache (author: eric) — prefers Tue AM
- RFC 422: quantization profiles (author: olivia) — prefers Wed
- RFC 423: rollout policy tweaks (author: sam) — flexible

maria: I can take the Tue AM slot if eric can move to Wed afternoon.

eric: I actually have a dependent PR blocking me — would prefer to keep Tue AM. Can we move olivia earlier instead?

olivia: I can swap to Tue 10:30 if that helps. pinged my calendar.

sam: Fine by me to go last. Also quick ask: can reviewers skim pre-reads by Mon EOD? I left a short PR with "known nits" in the RFC.

jamal: Yes please — pre-reads by Mon EOD. I'll post a 5-min TL;DR for each RFC in the thread.

jamal: TL;DRs:
```
RFC 421: KV-cache streaming fixes — 5min overview, main decision: single-writer vs batched flush.
RFC 422: Quant profiles — proposal for int8 fallback path, perf vs quality tradeoffs.
RFC 423: Rollout policy — canary triggers + fallback rules; small config schema change.
```

maria: @eric @olivia can you confirm calendar swaps? If yes I'll update the agenda order.

devx-bot: calendar poll created — /poll set: Tue 10:30, Tue 14:00, Wed 11:00. Vote using :ballot_box_with_ballot: 

eric: Voted for Tue 14:00 (if needed). Also added a short test checklist to the RFC 421 PR.

olivia: Confirmed Tue 10:30 works for me.

jamal: Great — provisional order now: 421 (10:30), 422 (11:00), 423 (afternoon). Maria please confirm and I'll send reminder + pre-read ping on Mon.

maria: Confirmed. I'll post the agenda and pre-read reminders Monday 9am.

sam: One more thing — bring up rollout metrics we want to see (latency, error-rate, cost/tokens). I'll add a slide.

jamal: Awesome. Thanks all. If anyone can't make it ping me directly so I can move slots.
